accum_resident_v3_3_16_16: Accumulator-resident vfmacc.vf micro-kernel tuning point (MR=3, NR=16, KC=16), registered on demand so the beam can tune the register block continuously. Compiler-emitted (no ukernel). Default-off.
accum_resident_v3kb_3_16_16: Accumulator-resident micro-kernel with REAL K-blocking (MR=3, NR=16, KC=16): K tiled by KC for cache reuse of the B panel, then by 1 for the register-resident accumulation. Compiler-emitted (no ukernel). Default-off.
accum_resident_v3p_3_16_4_8_16: Accumulator-resident vfmacc.vf micro-kernel with a per-op-class register block (linalg.matmul [3, 16], linalg.batch_matmul [1, 4, 8], KC=16), registered on demand so a shape-aware policy can pick a blocking that masks no parallel dim. Compiler-emitted (no ukernel). Default-off.
accum_resident_v3u_3_16_16: Accumulator-resident micro-kernel with M UNROLLED into 3 independent accumulators (NR=16, KC=16) — shape-agnostic in MR, unlike the 2-D vector<MRxNR> formulation. Compiler-emitted (no ukernel). Default-off.
accum_resident_v3vl_3_16_16: VL-AGNOSTIC accumulator-resident micro-kernel (MR=3, NR=16 lanes at the RVV minimum VLEN -> vector<[8]xT>, KC=16): the N register block is a SCALABLE vector, so the emitted loop sizes to the hardware's runtime vector length (vsetvli against VLMAX) instead of a compile-time width that the backend must widen for the worst-case VLEN. Needs no _zvl march pin. N loop is peeled so the main body is unmasked; the remainder is a scalar tail. Compiler-emitted (no ukernel). Default-off.
accumulator_resident_wholemodel_vf_mrpad: accumulator_resident_wholemodel_vf_mrpad at MR=3/NR=16/NR_bmm=8 with padding values typed for a i8xi8->i32 contraction. Same recipe and same tail rule; only the pad literals differ, because a wrongly-typed pad value is a transform-interpreter error and therefore a silent whole-model scalar fallback.
perop_register_block_1b_16_dc72d7bfbcc2: Per-op register blocking: 1 distinct blocks over 1 contraction geometries, KC=16. Each contraction is tiled at the widest block legal for its own extents, matched by the merlin.blk_<MR>x<NR> tag the prepare step applies after specialization. Replaces the per-op-CLASS block, whose smallest member otherwise clamps the whole class (measured: whisper_tiny claims 65.9% of its MACs per class vs 100% per op).
perop_register_block_mr5: request PER-CONTRACTION register blocking with the MR cap pinned to 5. Identical to perop_register_block except the cap is NAMED rather than read from MERLIN_PEROP_MR_CAP, so the beam can search it: the best cap is a property of the model's shapes (measured 1.125x from 4 -> 8 on an M=8, traffic-bound model; no further gain at 16). A sentinel, resolved by prepare_for_lowering. Default-off; baseline byte-identical.
perop_register_block_nr7: request PER-CONTRACTION register blocking with the NR cap pinned to 7. Identical to perop_register_block except the N cap is named and therefore searchable and reproducible. This exposes the model-specific tradeoff between wider panels and i32 accumulator register pressure. A sentinel resolved by prepare_for_lowering; default-off and baseline byte-identical.
vectorize_non_contraction_generics_l16_r: Bounded per-rank vectorize of the non-contraction all-parallel generics at 16 innermost lanes, loop ranks 2..5 (see vectorize_non_contraction_generics). Default-off; both numbers must be chosen by measurement, not assumed.
